Cost: 250eb (Expensive)

By tweaking nanobots meant for surgeries, flexible fabric weaves can be modified to resist tearing, toxins, or even electrical shocks.

SP 8 or lower Body Armor Enhancement. When installed, choose one of the following abilities for the armor to gain:

  • Padded: The armor's SP is no longer halved by any source of damage except weapons with a charged Tech Rebuild.
  • Multilayered: The first time in a Round the armor’s SP is reduced by any source, the ablation it suffers is reduced by 1.
  • Insulated: While the armor has at least 1 SP, whenever one or more pieces of the user’s cyberware would be rendered inoperable by a single EMP effect, this enhancement is rendered inoperable instead for the same amount of time as the EMP effect would normally last.

Type: Armor Enhancement (Body Armor, SP 8 or lower)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Enhancements & Kits).
